```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)

source("R/helpers.R")
source("R/prep.R")
source("R/plots.R")

# Validate right after reading, so bad data stops here and not in a figure.
visits <- readr::read_csv("data/ed_visits.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  validate_ed_visits()
patients <- readr::read_csv("data/patients.csv", show_col_types = FALSE)

monthly <- monthly_counts(visits, data_end = study_window[2])
payers <- payer_summary(visits)
curve <- lorenz_curve(patient_costs(visits, patients)$ed_cost)
```

## Summary

*Two or three sentences for leadership: how are ED visits trending, which payers drive visits and pay least, and how concentrated is cost?*
